title: Request ratings only after demonstrated engagement

statement.en: Ask for a rating only after people demonstrate engagement with the app or game.
statement.ja: 利用者がappまたはgameへのengagementを示した後にだけratingを依頼する。

conditions: Use meaningful signals such as launches, explored features, completed levels, or significant tasks.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Ratings and reviews experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるRatings and reviewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Avoid interrupting active tasks with rating requests

statement.en: Avoid interrupting people with a rating request while they perform a task or play a game.
statement.ja: task実行中またはgame play中にrating requestで利用者を中断しない。

conditions: A rating request would disrupt the current activity.
